slides.title: Chemistry capability: analogue preparation and route scout
slides.subtitle: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd | Draft 2 for internal review | 16 May 2007

slides.title: Who we are
bullets: Medicinal chemistry in Nottingham since March 1994
We make analogue sets for lead optimisation and scout the routes to them
Every compound we deliver is made in our own laboratories and sent with its compound card

bullets.text: Isolated material and proposed structures are kept apart in every report

slides.title: What we offer
bullets: Analogue preparation, priced per compound
Route scout and delivery, priced per route
Chemistry note on every programme, summarising the route risk and the next analogue
slides.notes: Pricing slide follows. Partners always ask about volume, so keep the discount line visible.

slides.title: How a programme runs
bullets: Hypothesis agreed with the partner's medicinal chemists
Route scout: one or more routes tested on the core
Route gate: go or no-go on the route before any analogue is made
Analogue set made and isolated; each compound gets a compound card
Delivery lot shipped with the chemistry note

slides.title: Reporting standards
bullets: Isolated material reported with isolated yield in mg
Purity by HPLC area percent
Masses from the bench may be recorded in g where the balance was not suitable
bullets_right: Proposed structures are labelled as proposed
Route risks listed before the next analogue is chosen
Structure assignment stated, with the method used

slides.title: Isolation gates (illustrative)
bullets: Gate 1: starting material confirmed by 1H NMR
Gate 2: crude route product isolated; yield recorded in mg
Gate 3: purity by area percent before a delivery lot is released
slides.notes: Gates are illustrative for this deck. Each programme sets its own.
